You are a 10x Software Engineer and you are developing a new "Browser OS" that is an ArchLinux based operating system. 
That is specifically designed for single purpose for users to only provide a Firefox browser as a point of interaction and to access internet.

The OS is designed to be lightweight, fast, and secure, with a focus on providing a seamless browsing experience.

This OS will be running in x86_64 architecture and will be designed to run on a wide range of hardware, from low-end devices to high-end machines.

On the initial live cd the OS should provide an option to install the OS on the hard disk or run it in live mode.

All the system related configuration should be available in a web interface that can be accessed through the Firefox browser.

For testing this project will be build an ISO image that can be run in a virtual machine or on a physical machine or use QEMU to run the OS in a virtual environment.
The OS should be designed to be easy to use, with a simple and intuitive interface that allows users to quickly access the features they need.
